title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Key Points of the Work of the People's Courts in 2018
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the 2018 Work Priorities of the People's Courts

Fa Fa [2018] No. 3

To: High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The 2018 Work Priorities of the People's Courts are hereby issued for your careful implementation.

February 8, 2018

2018 Work Priorities of the People's Courts

The general requirements for the work of the people's courts in 2018 are: thoroughly study and implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second and Third Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee, adhere to Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as the guide, adhere to the "three consistencies," adhere to the Party's absolute leadership over the work of the people's courts, adhere to justice for the people and fair justice, firmly grasp the new mission entrusted to the people's courts by the new era, in accordance with the "five-sphere integrated plan" for the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics and the "four-pronged comprehensive strategy," closely focus on the goal of "ensuring that the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case," faithfully fulfill the duties of adjudicative organs as conferred by the Constitution and laws, deepen judicial system reform, comprehensively promote the construction of smart courts, forge a court team that is both politically strong and highly competent, effectively safeguard national political security, ensure overall social stability, promote social fairness and justice, and guarantee the people's peace and contentment, strive to create a secure political environment, a stable social environment, a fair legal environment, and a high-quality service environment, and provide strong judicial services and guarantees for securing a decisive victory in building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and for winning the great victory of socialism with Chinese characteristics for a new era. Focus on the following ten aspects of work:

I. Thoroughly Study and Implement the Spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, Always Adhere to Arming the Mind, Guiding Practice, and Promoting Work with Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era

1. Thoroughly study and implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China. Take thorough study and implementation of the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China as the primary political task of the people's courts for the current and future period, carry out in-depth "big studies" and "big investigations," continuously make efforts to understand, grasp, and implement the spirit, translate the goals, tasks, and strategic deployments determined by the 19th National Congress into the work tasks of the people's courts, and manifest the learning outcomes in the improvement of capabilities and levels and in promoting new development in the work of the people's courts.

2. Thoroughly study, publicize, and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era. Deeply understand and accurately grasp the core essence, historical status, and rich connotation of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, guide the vast number of cadres and police in people's courts to improve political standing, establish historical perspective, strengthen theoretical thinking, enhance overall awareness, enrich knowledge literacy, adhere to a problem-oriented approach, and always adhere to arming the mind, guiding practice, and promoting work with Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era.

3. Thoroughly study and implement the important speech delivered by General Secretary Xi Jinping when presiding over a meeting of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee to hear the work report of the Leading Party Members' Group of the Supreme People's Court. Combine the actual work of the courts, transform the important speech spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping into a powerful driving force for promoting new development in the work of the people's courts in the new era, do every task in detail with the spirit of nailing, better serve and guarantee the overall economic and social development, unswervingly deepen judicial system reform, comprehensively strengthen the Party building of the people's courts, and with a better mental state and a higher work standard, promote the implementation of the major policies and decisions of the Party Central Committee in the people's courts.

4. Firmly establish the "Four Consciousnesses" (consciousness of the need to maintain political integrity, think in big-picture terms, follow the leadership core, and keep in alignment with the central Party leadership), and resolutely uphold the authority and centralized, unified leadership of the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core. Resolutely uphold President Xi Jinping's core position in the CPC Central Committee and the Party as a whole, resolutely uphold the authority and centralized, unified leadership of the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, resolutely achieve the following: uphold the core, be absolutely loyal, obey the Party's command, and be courageous to take responsibility. Unswervingly follow the path of socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics, ensure that the work of the people's courts always advances in the correct political direction. Conscientiously implement the responsibility system for ideological work, clearly oppose and resist various erroneous viewpoints, and safeguard ideological security. Be clear-cut in political matters, strictly observe political discipline and political rules, strictly implement the Party Constitution and other intra-Party regulations, and ensure that the implementation of the Party Central Committee's decisions and deployments is carried out without compromise in all aspects and throughout the entire process of the people's courts.

5. Thoroughly study and implement the spirit of the Central Conference on Political and Legal Work. Thoroughly study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on political and legal work and the important speech spirit of Comrade Guo Shengkun at the Central Conference on Political and Legal Work, unify ideological understanding with the major decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission on political and legal work, and effectively grasp and implement them in combination with the actual work of the courts.

6. Conscientiously implement the spirit of the 21st National Conference of the People's Courts. In accordance with the deployments of the 21st National Conference of the People's Courts, further clarify the goals and tasks, implement responsibilities at all levels, ensure that the various decisions and deployments made at the conference are implemented, effectively fulfill the main tasks of safeguarding national political security, ensuring overall social stability, promoting social fairness and justice, and guaranteeing the people's peace and contentment, and create a favorable rule-of-law environment for sustained and healthy economic and social development.

II. Resolutely Safeguard National Security and Social Stability, Effectively Protect the Rights and Interests of the People

7. Strengthen criminal trial work. Adjudicate all types of criminal cases in accordance with the law, severely crack down on various activities of infiltration, subversion, destruction, violence, and terrorism, always prioritize safeguarding national political security, especially the security of political power and institutions. Severely punish serious violent crimes such as homicide and robbery, severely punish crimes endangering food and drug safety, illegal fundraising, telecommunications fraud, crimes involving guns and explosives, pornography, gambling, drugs, pyramid schemes, trafficking, and abduction, to ensure the people's peace and contentment. Punish corruption crimes in accordance with the law, persist in punishing both bribery and corruption offenders, resolutely punish corruption crimes occurring among the people, severely punish "flies" (low-level corrupt officials) in poverty alleviation and livelihood areas, and corruption protected by organized crime. Actively cooperate with the reform of the national supervision system, ensure organic connection between judicial trials and national supervision. Strengthen judicial protection for groups such as the elderly, children, women, school students, and left-behind persons, and enhance the trial of cases involving minors. Severely punish all types of new cybercrimes in accordance with the law, strengthen research and response work, and promote the improvement of network governance capabilities. Perfect the mechanism for effectively preventing and promptly correcting miscarriages of justice, and strengthen judicial protection of human rights.

8. Deeply carry out the special campaign against organized crime and local despots. Resolutely implement the requirements of the "Notice of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on Carrying out the Special Campaign against Organized Crime and Local Despots," in accordance with the deployment of the national teleconference on the special campaign against organized crime and local despots, lawfully, accurately, and forcefully punish various criminal forces of organized crime and local despots, with a focus on severely cracking down on crimes that threaten political security, seize control of grassroots political power, "village bullies," evil clan forces, "protective umbrellas," as well as "soft violence," illegal lending and debt collection, to effectively enhance the people's sense of gain, happiness, and security. Adhere to the principle of severe punishment in accordance with the law, strictly handle cases in accordance with the law, and ensure that every case is resolved to be ironclad. Promote the construction of a long-term mechanism for preventing and punishing organized crime and local despots. Actively participate in comprehensive social security management, promote the improvement of mechanisms for social risk assessment, early warning, and prevention, and promote the construction of a social security prevention and control system.

9. Strengthen civil trial work. Adjudicate all types of civil cases in accordance with the law, effectively protect and improve people's livelihood. Deepen the reform of civil trial systems and mechanisms such as family trial. Adhere to the combination of rule of law and rule of virtue, practice and promote the core socialist values. Serve the rural revitalization strategy, properly adjudicate cases involving "agriculture, rural areas, and farmers," such as cases concerning the separation of three types of rights (ownership, contract rights, and management rights) of contracted land and land expropriation compensation, and promote the construction of a rural governance system that combines self-governance, rule of law, and rule of virtue. Properly adjudicate cases involving the military, legally support the full cessation of paid services, and safeguard national defense security and the legitimate rights and interests of military personnel and their families.

10. Strengthen administrative trial work. Adjudicate administrative cases in accordance with the law, support and supervise administrative organs in exercising their powers in accordance with the law. Strengthen the review of legality, legally correct the illegal actions of administrative organs, provide guidance for non-standard actions, and supervise administrative organs in performing their duties in accordance with the law. Take the substantive resolution of administrative disputes as the starting point of work, further strengthen mediation and reconciliation work. Promote the standardized law enforcement behavior of administrative organs by releasing white papers on administrative trials, judicial suggestions, and typical cases.

11. Strengthen state compensation and judicial assistance work. Properly adjudicate all types of state compensation cases, especially major criminal miscarriages of justice and cases of erroneous enforcement, illegal preservation, etc. Improve the legal system and working mechanism for state compensation, promote the improvement of the legal normative system for state compensation and assistance. Promote the standardization and legalization of judicial assistance.

12. Strengthen measures for facilitating and benefiting the people. Accelerate the transformation and upgrading of litigation service centers, comprehensively expand the breadth and depth of litigation services. Summarize and promote the work experience of "the masses discussing matters, judges explaining the law" and practices such as "courts on vehicles" and circuit trials, properly resolve conflicts and disputes. Deepen the reform of the petition mechanism related to litigation, strictly implement the system of final disposition in accordance with the law. Strengthen the protection of lawyers' professional rights, increase the construction of lawyer service platforms, promote lawyers to play a greater role in resolving petitions and representing appeals, and cooperate in promoting the pilot work of lawyer mediation.

III. Guided by Xi Jinping's Economic Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, Create a Favorable Rule-of-Law Environment for Promoting High-Quality Economic Development

13. Serve and guarantee the implementation of major national strategies and supply-side structural reform. Legally guarantee the smooth implementation of major national strategies such as coordinated regional development and sustainable development, serve the coordinated development of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt, and the construction of the Xiongan New Area. Properly adjudicate new types of cases arising from deepening supply-side structural reform, pay special attention to cases involving the "Internet+" economy, sharing economy, and other fields, and guide and regulate innovation-driven development. Strengthen bankruptcy trial work, improve the mechanisms for market entity rescue and exit. Take the disposal of "zombie enterprises" as an important starting point, improve the bankruptcy reorganization mechanism for distressed enterprises, serve industrial structure adjustment and the implementation of modern enterprise systems, and guarantee the in-depth advancement of the "five priority tasks: cutting overcapacity, reducing excess inventory, deleveraging, lowering costs, and strengthening areas of weakness." Focus on the three tasks of serving the real economy, preventing and controlling financial risks, and deepening financial reform, strengthen the professionalization of financial trials, and continuously improve the ability of financial trials. Strengthen the judicial protection of property rights, equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of non-public economic entities and individuals, properly handle cases involving property rights formed historically, and promote the stimulation and protection of entrepreneurial spirit.

14. Strengthen intellectual property trial work. Conscientiously implement the "Opinions on Several Issues Concerning Strengthening Reform and Innovation in the Field of Intellectual Property Trials" issued by the General Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the General Office of the State Council, continuously deepen reforms in the field of intellectual property trials, give full play to the leading role of judicial protection of intellectual property rights, optimize the rule-of-law environment for scientific and technological innovation, and serve the implementation of the innovation-driven development strategy. Address key areas and weak links that affect and restrict the development of intellectual property trials, improve litigation systems such as intellectual property evidence rules, jurisdiction layout, and trial methods, strengthen the construction of the intellectual property court system, strengthen the construction of the intellectual property trial team, and improve the trial systems and mechanisms that conform to the laws of intellectual property protection and the judicial protection system of intellectual property with Chinese characteristics.

15. Strengthen environmental resources trial work. Adjudicate all types of environmental resources cases in accordance with the law, punish criminal acts of polluting the environment and destroying ecology, and promote the improvement of the legal system for green production and consumption. Promote the comprehensive implementation of environmental public interest litigation, especially the system of procuratorial public interest litigation, explore and improve the litigation system for ecological and environmental damage compensation, and build a system for the restoration and compensation of ecological and environmental damage. Improve the trial system and mechanism for environmental resources, and enhance the professional level of environmental resources trials.

16. Strengthen foreign-related commercial and maritime trials, trials involving Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan, and foreign affairs work. Conscientiously implement the "Opinions on Establishing a Dispute Resolution Mechanism and Institution for the 'Belt and Road'" approved by the second meeting of the Central Leading Group for Deepening Overall Reform, promote the construction of the International Commercial Court of the Supreme People's Court and the construction of the diversified dispute resolution mechanism for the 'Belt and Road,' properly resolve relevant disputes in accordance with the law, equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties, and promote the creation of a stable, fair, and transparent rule-of-law business environment. Serve the construction of free trade pilot zones, free trade ports, etc., improve the foreign-related commercial and maritime trial mechanism. Serve the construction of a maritime power, build a modern maritime trial system with Chinese characteristics suitable for a maritime power. Properly adjudicate disputes involving Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan, equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of compatriots from Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan in accordance with the law, and actively serve the construction of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area.

IV. Adhere to Strict and Fair Justice, Continuously Improve Trial Quality, Efficiency, and Judicial Credibility

17. Unswervingly uphold the authority of the Constitution and laws. Conscientiously implement the spirit of the Second Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, resolutely support the Party Central Committee's proposal to amend parts of the Constitution, and resolutely uphold the authority of the Constitution. Implement the requirements of the judicial responsibility system, truly realize that those who try cases make judgments and those who make judgments are responsible. Strictly implement systems such as the "two provisions" (provisions on preventing and interfering in the handling of cases) to prevent and intervene in cases, ensure the independent and impartial exercise of adjudicative power in accordance with the law. Strengthen the punishment of acts such as contempt of court, insulting judges, and refusing to comply with effective judgments of the court, and safeguard the dignity of the national rule of law.

18. Adhere to strict justice. Strictly implement the three major procedural laws and relevant judicial interpretations, ensure that the facts are clearly ascertained, the law is correctly applied, the trial procedure is lawful, the judgment result is fair, and ensure the unity of procedural justice and substantive justice. Strictly implement legal principles and systems such as the principle of legality for crimes and penalties, the principle of putting doubt aside when evidence is insufficient, the principle of adjudication based on evidence, and the exclusion of illegally obtained evidence. Improve the mechanism for effectively preventing and promptly correcting miscarriages of justice, strictly control the facts, evidence, procedures, and application of law in each case. Effectively enhance the awareness of the overall situation, combine legal principles and sentiment, maintain public order and good customs, and prevent mechanical justice and handling cases purely by the book.

19. Strengthen trial management. Implement the requirement of balanced case resolution, conscientiously carry out case clearing and evaluation, and increase the rate of case resolution within the prescribed time limit. Strictly manage the trial time limits, resolutely clean up and correct criminal cases that have been pending for a long time without judgment and civil cases that have not been concluded for a long time. Formulate procedural standards covering the main trial procedures in professional fields such as criminal, civil, administrative, and state compensation, to improve the standardization level of trial work. Improve the trial performance evaluation mechanism to promote judicial fairness and efficiency.

20. Strengthen judicial research. Strengthen the research, publicity, and implementation of Xi Jinping's thought on the rule of law, and produce a number of high-level research results. Strengthen judicial research on the deployments of the 19th National Congress on deepening the practice of rule of law and deepening the comprehensive supporting reform of the judicial system, and ensure that correct legal theory leads legal practice. Give full play to the role of the research platform of the people's courts, and strengthen research on trial theory and judicial cases.

(End of Part 1)

27. Advance the reform of the criminal procedure system centered on the trial. Improve the three procedural rules for pretrial conferences, exclusion of illegal evidence, and court investigation to further promote substantive trials. Deepen the pilot reform of the leniency system for guilty pleas and acceptance of punishment, improve the institutional framework and rule application, strengthen supervision, checks, and supporting safeguards, and promote the comprehensive coverage of defense lawyers in criminal cases and the work of legal aid duty lawyers, so as to promote the construction of a litigation system for minor crimes with Chinese characteristics. Fully utilize modern information technology, summarize and promote the experience of Shanghai and Guizhou in establishing basic evidence standards and intelligent case handling assistance in criminal cases, and build a new model of criminal justice that meets the needs of the times.

28. Improve the court organizational system. Deepen the reform of the circuit courts of the Supreme People's Court, and improve the circuit trial system with Chinese characteristics. Deepen reform measures such as cross-administrative-region courts and intellectual property courts, explore the establishment of specialized courts and tribunals in areas such as the Internet, finance, and environmental resources, and promote the modernization of the court organizational system. In accordance with the requirement that "institutional streamlining is the foundation, and functional optimization is the key," actively advance the internal institutional reform of the People's Courts.

29. Consolidate the achievements of the case-filing registration system reform and promote the construction of a diversified dispute resolution mechanism. Promptly study and resolve new situations and problems arising after the reform of the case-filing registration system, improve the comprehensive, multi-faceted registration and case-filing system, and intensify efforts to combat frivolous litigation, malicious litigation, and unreasonable persistent litigation. Relying on the in-depth promotion of the construction of modern litigation service centers, deepen the work of separating complex and simple cases and mediation and expedited adjudication. Thoroughly study and implement Comrade Mao Zedong's instruction to promote the "Fengqiao Experience" and General Secretary Xi Jinping's instruction to uphold and develop the "Fengqiao Experience," actively explore the pilot reform of pre-litigation mediation procedures, and further promote the construction of a diversified dispute resolution mechanism. Advance the reform of the litigation fee system, leveraging the role of the litigation fee system in case triage and its leveraging function within the national governance system.

VII. Accelerate the construction of smart courts through the use of modern technology

30. Modernize the trial system and trial capacity through informatization. Comprehensively promote tool reshaping, improve the intelligent case handling assistance system, and expand and deepen the systematic application of big data and artificial intelligence in the judicial field. Strengthen investment in the construction of information technology infrastructure, promote resource integration and mutual compatibility among platforms, and enhance the level of network security protection. Comprehensively promote process reshaping, constructing a judicial process and trial mechanism that better conforms to the laws of the Internet.

31. Strengthen and expand the functionality of judicial big data. Conduct in-depth research on judicial big data, continuously improve data collection, analysis, and application, and effectively enhance the scientific and accurate nature of judicial forecasting and decision-making. Increase technical integration, business integration, and data integration with various departments and entities, promoting both the resolution of the judiciary's own difficulties and the improvement of social governance levels. Centering on the overall situation of economic and social development, construct a judicial social governance index and a judicial fairness index, profoundly revealing the inherent relationship between judicial activities and economic and social development, providing scientific references for Party committees and government decision-making. Utilize judicial big data to provide high-quality social public services and judicial public goods, offering risk assessment, early warning, and analysis services to relevant units.

32. Comprehensively deepen judicial transparency. Pay greater attention to the new characteristics of the mobile Internet era, and rely on technical means to comprehensively expand the breadth and depth of judicial transparency. Increase the construction and integration of various transparency platforms, promoting the transformation of platforms from one-way disclosure to multi-way interaction. Expand the scope of live broadcast of court trials, online publication of judgments, and disclosure of various types of judicial information, urging judges to enhance their judicial capabilities and improve their judicial conduct. Strengthen judicial publicity work, both by strengthening positive public opinion guidance and by addressing negative public opinion responses, and build an all-media platform for judicial news publicity.

VIII. Conscientiously implement the general requirements for Party building in the new era, and persistently strengthen the construction of the People's Court workforce

33. Always give top priority to political construction. In accordance with the unified deployment of the Party Central Committee, and combined with promoting the normalization and institutionalization of the "Learn the Party Constitution and regulations, and a series of important speeches, and be a qualified Party member" education, meticulously organize and carry out the "Remain true to our original aspiration and keep our mission firmly in mind" themed education. Do a good job in political rotation training, give full play to the role of the court Party school and the Judge College and its branches, compile training materials, and arrange political courses well. Treat special supervision of political construction as a regular and institutionalized task, incorporating the strict observance of political discipline and political rules, and the implementation of the Party Central Committee's decisions and deployments into the scope of supervision, conducting tier-by-tier supervision and on-site inspections.

34. Focus on improving judicial capacity. Vigorously promote standardization, professionalization, and professional development, striving to build a court team that is both politically strong and highly competent. Implement the principle of the Party managing cadres, implement the "good cadre" standards, adhere to the correct orientation for selecting and appointing personnel, emphasize political standards, and promote and appoint cadres who have firmly established the "Four Consciousnesses" and the "Four Matters of Confidence," resolutely uphold the authority of the Party Central Committee, fully implement the Party's line, principles, and policies, are loyal, honest, and responsible, and adhere to justice for the people and impartial justice. In accordance with the requirements of enhancing the "Eight Capabilities," vigorously strengthen education and training work. Make full use of the China Judge Training Network to promote the co-construction and sharing of high-quality course resources. Carry out in-depth national law enforcement and judicial inspections to solve problems of lax, non-standard, unfair, and uncivilized justice. Improve the talent development plan for courts, and deepen the joint training mechanism for rule-of-law talents between courts and universities. Strengthen the protection of court police officers in the performance of their duties, and make every effort to ensure that policies for preferential treatment of police officers are implemented.

35. Deeply promote the construction of court culture. Advance the innovative development of court culture, and strive to build a new era court culture centered on loyalty and responsibility, justice for the people, neutrality and modesty, and integrity and discipline. Conduct in-depth activities to learn from advanced models such as Zou Bihua, Huang Zhili, Liu Li, Guo Xingli, and Fang Jingang, guiding police officers to uphold the spirit of the rule of law and professional ethics, to be good judges who are impartial and serve the people in the new era, and good cadres who dare to take responsibility. Fully utilize platforms such as the Chinese Judicial Research Association to promote the inheritance and development of Chinese judicial culture.

36. Unswervingly advance the construction of Party conduct, integrity, and the fight against corruption. Conscientiously fulfill the "Two Responsibilities" for comprehensively and strictly governing the Party, adhere to strict education, strict management, and strict supervision, implement the "Four Forms" of supervision and discipline enforcement, strictly enforce regulations such as avoiding conflicts of interest, preventing interference in cases, and regulating interactions between judicial personnel and relevant parties, and urge police officers to revere the rules, maintain vigilance, and hold the bottom line. Investigate and rectify new trends and new manifestations of the "Four Forms of Decadence," and resolutely prevent the rebound of these issues. Adhere to no forbidden zones, full coverage, and zero tolerance, severely punish violations of discipline and law by police officers, and strive to establish a long-term mechanism within the court system that ensures they dare not, cannot, and do not want to engage in corruption.

IX. Take solid progress in grassroots basic construction as the starting point, and promote the comprehensive improvement of grassroots judicial capacity and standards

37. Strengthen the construction of Party organizations at grassroots courts. Conscientiously implement the Party Central Committee's deployment on strengthening the construction of grassroots Party organizations, and make grassroots Party organizations in courts strong fighting fortresses that propagate the Party's propositions, implement the Party's decisions, unite and lead the masses, serve and gather police officers, and promote court reform and development. Improve the system for establishing full-time Party affairs workers in Party branches, focus on training the leaders of grassroots Party organizations, and enhance the level of grassroots Party affairs work. Summarize experiences and practices such as establishing Party groups within trial and enforcement teams, and setting up mobile Party branches in aspects such as diversified dispute resolution, ensuring that Party organizations and member management are implemented at the front line of trial and enforcement, and that the Party's combat effectiveness and cohesion are exerted at the forefront of judicial reform.

38. Increase support for the grassroots frontline. Increase policy tilt and resource support, giving priority to grassroots levels in judge training, funding guarantees, material equipment, and information technology construction. Optimize the layout of people's tribunals, explore the establishment of specialized and comprehensive tribunals, and improve working conditions for grassroots courts and people's tribunals in remote and economically underdeveloped areas. Enhance the effectiveness of aid work for Tibet and Xinjiang, do a good job in targeted poverty alleviation by the court system, and support and assist the construction of grassroots courts in minority, border, and impoverished areas. Adhere to the system of mobile lecture tours by teaching groups, and deepen the implementation of the "Thousand Talents Program" for bilingual judges. Adhere to treating grassroots as a cradle for cultivating cadres, and smooth channels for exchange, training, selection, and promotion of cadres between higher and lower-level courts. Strengthen security work in the People's Courts to ensure the personal safety of litigants and court police officers, and the safety of trial and office premises.

39. Improve the mechanism for supervision and guidance over lower courts. Perfect mechanisms for macro-guidance and categorized guidance over lower courts, and improve the mechanism for uniform application of law. Accurately grasp the different functions of first instance, second instance, and retrial, and pay attention to regulating and strengthening the supervisory functions of higher-level courts over trial levels. Conscientiously perform duties of supervision over judicial administrative affairs such as funding and equipment, judicial police, and trial affairs supervision, ensuring that courts at all levels act in unison and develop in an orderly manner.

X. Consciously accept supervision, and continuously improve the work of the People's Courts

40. Strengthen liaison work with deputies to the People's Congress and members of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC). Innovate communication methods, make full use of online communication platforms for deputies and members and mobile information platforms for deputies and members, carry out communication and liaison efficiently and conveniently, and smooth channels for public opinion. Hear opinions and suggestions from deputies and members by inviting them to inspect courts, participate in important meetings and activities, and attend court hearings. Improve the communication and coordination mechanism with various democratic parties, the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce, people's organizations, and non-party personages.

41. Conscientiously handle suggestions from deputies and proposals from CPPCC members. Carefully summarize experiences, improve working mechanisms, and solidly handle the suggestions from National People's Congress deputies, proposals from CPPCC members, and cases of concern, promptly provide feedback on progress and results, strengthen communication and explanation efforts, and strive to gain the understanding and support of deputies and members.

42. Prepare well for the special work report on addressing the difficulty of enforcement. Strengthen investigation and research, carefully summarize the experiences of various regions in advancing the basic resolution of enforcement difficulties, analyze, research, and assess the new situations and problems arising in the process, and jointly prepare the special report. Seize this opportunity to rely on the Party's leadership, supervision by the People's Congress, and support from all sides, promote the improvement of the comprehensive governance work pattern for enforcement difficulties, and encourage all sectors of society to further build consensus and form a joint effort, providing stronger guarantees for winning the tough battle of "basically resolving the difficulty of enforcement within two to three years."
